model.promotion_notes: PROMOTED on 2026-09-03: XGBoost challenger tested against the Logistic Regression baseline using a paired t-test over the SAME 5 StratifiedKFold folds (random_state=42, identical between cross_validate_baseline_v2.py and cross_validate_challenger_v2.py) â€” the same rigorous method used in v1, which in v1's case led to REJECTING XGBoost. Here the result is the opposite: XGBoost wins in 5/5 folds consistently (AUC diff ranging +0.0065 to +0.0105 across folds, no fold where it loses), with AUC +0.0084 (p=0.0002) and KS +0.0144 (p=0.0005) â€” both comfortably below the 0.05 significance threshold. This closes most of the performance gap between v2 and v1 (v1 baseline AUC=0.7664 vs v2 XGBoost AUC=0.7636, vs v2 Logistic Regression AUC=0.7551). Promoting XGBoost as the v2 production model on this evidence. Interpretability is reduced versus the Logistic Regression baseline, but SHAP-based explainability (see explain_model equivalent for v2, once built) restores per-request reason codes, same approach as v1's xgb_challenger before its own reversal.
